mapper.select: SELECT rml.menu_id FROM sys_user_role_link as url INNER JOIN sys_role as r ON url.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu_link as rml on r.id = rml.role_id WHERE user_id = #{userId} and url.bool_delete_enum = 0 and r.bool_delete_enum = 0 and rml.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT m.* FROM sys_role_menu_link as rml INNER JOIN sys_menu as m on rml.menu_id = m.id WHERE rml.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.category = #{category} and m.bool_delete_enum = 0 and rml.bool_delete_enum = 0
